# The Sake Wire / MADE IN AKITA

> The Sake Wire (sakewire.com) is a daily English-language news site about Japanese sake, shochu, whisky, wine and craft beer, written for readers in Europe. It is published by Danshiko Lab, the company that also runs MADE IN AKITA: an Amsterdam-based importer and trade desk for sake, wine, craft beer and gin from Akita Prefecture, Japan.

## MADE IN AKITA — Akita sake, wine and craft beer for EU trade buyers

- What we do: import and supply sake, wine, cider, craft beer and gin from 11 independent producers in Akita Prefecture, Japan, to restaurants, bars, retailers and distributors in the EU.
- Stock: held in Amsterdam, the Netherlands, and shipped across the EU. Additional volumes are exported from Japan on request.
- Who buys: Japanese and non-Japanese restaurants, wine and sake shops, importers and wholesalers in the Netherlands, Belgium, Germany and the rest of the EU.
- Trade enquiries (wholesale price list, samples, MOQ): trade@danshiko.com
- Online shop (consumers, EU): https://shop.made-in-akita.com
- Brand site: https://made-in-akita.com

## Producers we carry (Akita Prefecture)

- Okuda Shuzoten (Chiyomidori) — sake, Daisen
- Azakura Shuzo (Azakura) — sake, Yokote
- Naba Shoten (Ginrin) — sake, Akita City
- Kodama Jozo (Taiheizan) — sake and craft gin, Katagami
- Dainagawa — sake, Yokote
- Sato Shuzoten (Dewanofuji) — sake, Yurihonjo
- Chitosezakari Shuzo — sake, Kazuno
- Mutsumi Winery — wine and cider, Katagami
- Winery Konohana (Tokito) — wine, Kazuno
- TOYOSHIMA FARM (Harmonie) — wine, Yurihonjo
- Ogresse Quete (oga.) — craft beer, Oga
